topic: Checking frequency differences between ad types
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on investigating why the frequency metrics differ significantly between YouTube (YTS) and non-YouTube (non-YTS) inventory. It was confirmed that the frequency calculation should be performed using the ML API, not SQL.

[me] provided instructions for reloading specific dictionaries (`ml_frequency_logreg_http_dict_2`) on the cluster, advising [p1] to execute these commands himself. The reload procedure differs by environment: Production requires reloads №№1 and №№3, while Staging only requires №2.
decisions: Frequency calculation must use the ML API.
